title: Native App Builder - Claude Code Skill
description: Comprehensive Claude Code skill for building high-quality native applications across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and React Native with 60-120fps animations.
longDescription: An educational skill designed for Claude Code that teaches developers how to build Telegram-quality native applications with smooth animations and scalable architectures. Covers iOS (SwiftUI/UIKit), Android (Jetpack Compose), React Native (TurboModules/Reanimated 3), macOS, Windows (WinUI 3), and Linux (GTK 4/Qt 6). Includes 50+ animation patterns, profiling guides, Clean Architecture patterns, and a structured 6-week learning path from foundations to advanced techniques.
